title: Differentiate
author: Pleyar
selftext: can we have a tag/flair to differentiate AI assisted development from AI only development?

comments.author: Internal-Capital7471
comments.body:
It would be useless, because everyone considers it differently. You would get people who would consider only ai coded as assisting.. People who would consider only the art done with ai as assisting. Then you can get gritty with it, people who use it to help code like autocomplete vs fully code like vibe coding.

Theres no real reason to distinguish anyways. The hate will pile on no matter what

replies.author: Pleyar
replies.body: You have no reason to differentiate. Im interested see ho others integrate ai in game development while i dont have any interest in see games that are prompt only workflows.

comments.author: Big_Presentation2786
comments.body:
Here's the deal.. everyone uses AI.
Not just a few people in this sub, literally everyone in the trade uses it, from the guy whose making independent stuff to the guys making COD4..

The only people who truly give a shit if you're using AI, are the guys who don't like your game because you didn't work on the gameplay, and failed Devs who are too proud to just get their shit together and evolve..

replies.author: Pleyar
replies.body: How this relates to my point? Im just asking to differentiate development where all the work is doing by prompting from games where there are other tools in the workflow

replies.author: Big_Presentation2786
replies.body:
There is no line to differentiate..
Claude is used for code, other AI is used to generate assets for graphics.

AI is in every part of development.
It's quicker, reduces costs, and is more efficient than building shit in part.

replies.author: Big_Presentation2786
replies.body:
I'm not building anything.
I built my shit, steam reviews is positive

replies.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
replies.body: Be respectul to others and follow reddits guidelines and policies.
